title: Gentle Work Around the Elbow
summary: Very light movements are made around the elbow over soft tissue.
startingPosition: The elbow is slightly bent and supported.
instructions: Stroke the soft tissue around the joint.
direction: Around the joint over soft tissue.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
